GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: Owner confirmed full baseline feature parity, not an incremental MVP, and delegated all reversible technical decisions overnight. Native host contracts own API shapes; older generic OpenCode skill examples describe V1 and must not override the pinned V2 source. Branching from v1.7.0 leaves later archives in main history, not in this branch; do not retrofit or delete historical bundles.

Alternatives.Alternative: Rejected dual-runtime V1-shaped facades and no-op feature fallbacks. Reuse independent domain services; replace actual host boundaries with typed V2 services.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Release version, merge strategy into main, publication and compatibility beyond 2.0.18 are not part of this execution.

Core acceptance now uses input-correlated native evidence and persistent auxiliary parentage. The packed-host matrix must still exercise restart, reordered acceptance, cross-session equal-time ordering, all plugin consumers and full-product parity before final acceptance.

Scenarios.Scenario: The pinned host is /tmp/opencode/v2-native-2.0.18; binary is /tmp/opencode/vvoc-seam-host-2.0.18/opencode; historical evidence is /tmp/opencode/vvoc-e2e-v2-evidence/seam-seams-1790520177215.json with sibling capture and trace files. They are read-only research inputs, not current-code acceptance.

Native prompt hook is awaited before admission. Direct generate/synthetic requires a staged snapshot candidate and awaited switchModel before dispatch. An identical model switch emits no event; provenance relies on native config.updated, never forced /api/location/reload which disrupts the TUI.

Snapshot-qualified variants use model.transform/editor.update on real models and replay persisted captures. Service.discover plus plugin-instance RPC challenge authenticates the full client; credentials come only from service registration.

Title uses a snapshot-bound auxiliary child and session.generate, returning hook result. Do not use stateless experimental generate. SSE/WS text restoration must carry split placeholders while preserving opaque frames.

Native subagent inputs are agent/description/prompt/model?/sessionID?/background?; results are sessionID/status/output. Fork lineage may use fork.sessionID with empty parentID. Worktree movement must resolve lineage before dispatch.

Cancellation recovery requires affirmative parent error, child terminal abort, and quiescence evidence. Never refund an in-flight budget during hydration or use recovery wall-clock time for historical completion.

Further pinned-source investigation narrowed the historical seam evidence: direct generate succeeded through pre-admission RPC, not by switching in the late generate hook; the registry fixture supplied captured variants and explicitly configured a named seam-live variant; restart evidence continued with a new prompt, not automatic suspended-session recovery. These distinctions must be preserved in acceptance claims.

Native accepted input is session.inbox.enqueued with sessionID, inboxID and user/synthetic item; inboxID matches prompt.messageID. session.execution.started and model.request do not prove acceptance of an arbitrary staged candidate. Full client session.log with follow=false and log.synced provides durable reconciliation; pending inbox.list alone misses already-delivered inputs. No public prompt-rejected event is emitted when attachment/skill preparation fails after the prompt hook.

Model resolution precedes generate/context shaping hooks. Awaited prompt and authenticated HTTP RPC have an activation barrier; setup-time self HTTP RPC deadlocks activation. External setup transforms precede native configuration transforms. Named variant merging and variant-regeneration branches differ; final registry readback and real request payloads are required. model.updated is an output of model reload and must not unconditionally trigger another reload.

Intermediate diagnostics reproduced explicit-choice loss, default-variant mismatch, incompatible controller/auxiliary role selection, candidate replacement and rejected partial commit despite green unit tests. The accepted core correction retains up to eight exact per-input candidates, orders publication using native accepted-event evidence with complete log reconciliation, separates owned operations from prompts, and creates auxiliary sessions through the public native session.import route with verified persistent parentID. Later consumers must use familyOf/configFor rather than an ephemeral model-only exemption. Overflow fails closed without dropping existing candidates.

Core host smoke is optional test mode: VVOC_E2E_V2_HOST=/tmp/opencode/vvoc-seam-host-2.0.18/opencode VVOC_E2E_SCRATCH=/tmp/opencode bun test src/plugins/model-roles.integration.test.ts -t "real OpenCode". A controller run passed eighteen assertions and 141 focused cases. The later scripts/e2e-v2.ts --core harness passed twelve packed-host cases, including raw-unbound refusal, owned generate/synthetic, native permissions, fork/worktree, restart root/auxiliary replay and a delayed-preparation first-accepted case with distinct model policies. Core evidence is core-evidence.json. These are not full-product acceptance or final review; cross-session equal-time ordering remains a specific coverage limit.

V1 cancellation names describe semantics, not literal V2 fields: pinned subagent.ts emits Subagent cancelled or Tool execution interrupted, and native session errors use type=aborted; the host's own v1-migration maps MessageAbortedError to aborted. Native AssistantTool.time.completed is beside state, never state.time.completed. Recovery requires both exact terminal times, latest attributable aborted child, and authoritative active/inbox quiescence. Workflow now uses immutable family policy and same-child fresh report retrieval; two controller-run live smokes passed, including a real malformed-report continuation. Live native cancellation/background acceptance remains a T-009 obligation.

T-005 safety ports remain unaccepted despite 396 passing focused tests. A controller in-memory diagnostic using the actual hashline handlers proved legacy string content receives anchors while native content arrays do not. Pinned core/tool.ts and tool/runtime.ts normalize content to arrays before execute.after; hashline/index.ts currently handles only string result.content. Its filesystem reads, rename resolution, writes and read cache also use raw/process-relative paths instead of an explicit native location boundary, and custom access must preserve native external_directory authorization before access. Correct fixtures must use normalized native content and two isolated locations whose daemon cwd is different.

Safety integration evidence distinguishes intended aggregation from independent subpaths: the worker's real ModelRoles+Secrets composite on one actual Context succeeds with split-placeholder restoration, while separate plugin contexts are order-dependent (secrets-first fails with a captured-model mismatch). T-009 must resolve cross-context runtime coordination before claiming standalone-plugin composition. Do not hide this by testing components only in isolation. Direct effect/zod dependencies and the native editor.add registration census also remain T-009 work; the old census currently produces three known aggregate test failures.
